data.name: Modem Architecture and Modeling Engineer – Qualcomm, Hod HaSharon
data.jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm Israel Ltd.

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Modem Technologies

General Summary:


General Summary


We are looking for an engineer with strong System Modeling and System-level Analysis skills to drive new modem concepts, exploration and shaping.

The role will focus on developing models that enable early evaluation of architectural options, quantify trade-offs, and support data-driven HW architecture decisions.

The ideal candidate will have a broad system perspective and a solid understanding of interactions across SW, FW, and HW. They will work closely with architecture and design teams to translate new concepts into models, evaluate alternative approaches, identify system-level constraints and opportunities, and validate architectural assumptions before committing to implementation.


Key Areas of Responsibility


  • Develop system-level models to explore new concepts and architectural options.
  • Analyze and quantify trade-offs across performance, complexity, power, and implementation considerations.
  • Understand and model interactions across SW, FW, and HW boundaries.
  • Use modeling and simulation to validate assumptions, identify bottlenecks, and support HW architecture decisions.
  • Collaborate with architecture, HW, FW, and SW teams to translate modeling insights into practical design recommendations.
  • Prototype and evaluate selected concepts where modeling can reduce implementation risk or accelerate technical decisions.

Minimum Qualifications


  • B.Sc./M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Solid Computer Architecture System understanding.
  • Solid Wireless Communication and Modem System understanding.
  • Experience working across HW/SW boundaries.
  • Experience with C/C++ and modeling or simulation environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to independently investigate complex technical problems.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with LTE/5G, particularly PHY and modem systems.
  • Understanding of CPU architecture, memory hierarchy, caching, and system performance.
  • Experience with MATLAB-based modeling and simulation.
  • Python experience.
  • Background in HW/logic design.
  • Experience with performance modeling and architectural trade-off analysis.

Minimum Qualifications:

•    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

• 2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

*References to a particular number of years experience are for indicative purposes only. Applications from candidates with equivalent experience will be considered, provided that the candidate can demonstrate an ability to fulfill the principal duties of the role and possesses the required competencies.

Whether you’re launching a new career or ready to explore what’s next in the evolution of your talent and expertise, you’re about to embark on a career growth journey like no other.

Bring out your best, with the best
Our employees make Qualcomm’s success possible. We hire the brightest minds and foster a supportive, inclusive culture where your ideas have the power to contribute to world-changing innovations and breakthrough technologies. To make that possible, we leverage the breadth and depth of our diverse expertise from around the world to answer the unasked, conquer the complex, and solve some of the biggest challenges only we can – together.

Innovate with technology experts
At Qualcomm, we are passionate about the limitless potential of your career. Only here can you work alongside some of the most respected, leading engineering and technology experts in the industry – helping you learn and grow professionally in ways you haven’t yet imagined.

Live well, work well
Additionally, you’ll have access to programs such as our continuous learning and development programs, tuition reimbursement, and mentorships to tap into your limitless potential – plus, opportunities to enhance your quality of life through our comprehensive, best-in-class benefits offerings.

The work we do at Qualcomm impacts lives around the globe – and you can be part of it. Apply today and unlock your full potential.
